note: Real photos chosen to suit the wheel method: vehicles standing in shallow to moderate water with a tyre seen side-on and the waterline across it, mostly Indian streets. Wikimedia Commons (CC BY, CC BY-SA), Unsplash License and Pexels License only; author, licence and source are per photo, author names read from each photo page on 2026-11-01. The photos are not stored in git: eval/real_photos.py --sets wheel downloads them into eval/photos/. Nobody measured the water in any of them, so there is no ground truth. 'expect' is what I saw in the photo when choosing it, not a measurement.
